crossRefs.note: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here…
Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”
Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the…
Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan…
Then some of the elders of Israel came to me, and sat before me.
In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of…
For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.
“These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood…
“Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?”…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘Yahweh doesn’t see us. Yahweh has forsaken the land.’ ”
translations.bsb: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? For they are saying, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’”
translations.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
translations.asv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his chambers of imagery? for they say, Jehovah seeth us not; Jehovah hath forsaken the land.
